verdict.rationale: SendGrid publishes a REST API reference (mail-send endpoint docs) plus getting-started guides with cURL and SDK code samples, showing example requests, but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it now' console or embedded runnable playground in the docs themselves — sandbox mode only validates sends server-side, not via docs UI. missing for 10: evidence of an actual interactive API explorer/console, evidence that examples can be executed directly from the reference page, independent confirmation of this UX.
